function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies customer identity against record using last 4 digits of PAN or birth year before revealing any debt details. Must be called before any disclosure of loan or overdue amount.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

verification_code.description: The 4-digit PAN suffix or 4-digit birth year provided by the user.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Logs the agreed promise-to-pay date and amount committed by the customer. Only call after verify_customer has succeeded.

ptp_date.description: The ISO-8601 date agreed upon for payment, e.g., 2026-08-14

amount.description: The amount in INR the customer agreed to pay.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Triggers an instant payment link via SMS or WhatsApp to the customer's registered mobile number. Call only after a promise-to-pay has been logged.

channel.description: Delivery channel for the payment link.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Escalates the call/case to a human agent or grievance desk, used for hardship claims or disputes that the bot cannot resolve autonomously.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final call outcome and disposition status in the database. Must be called exactly once before every call ends, regardless of outcome.

notes.description: Free-text context about the outcome, e.g. payment reference, hardship reason, or termination cause.
